version_1_0.promotional_text: The ad-free team app parents don't hate. Schedules, RSVPs, team chat, and dues for every kid and every team — all in one place. Free for families.
version_1_0.description:
ClubHQ Team keeps youth sports teams organized — without ads, ever.

Coaches set up a team in minutes and share one team code. Parents join, add their kids, and instantly see every practice and game. Players 13 and up can get their own login from a parent or coach.

ONE APP FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
• Every kid, every team, one schedule
• RSVP for each child with one tap
• Locations with directions, arrival notes, and jersey reminders
• See what's coming up this week at a glance

BUILT FOR COACHES
• Create practices, games, and weekly repeating events
• See who's going, who's out, and who hasn't answered
• Take attendance and record final scores
• Post announcements everyone actually sees
• Invite families with a single team code — no roster typing

TEAM CHAT THAT'S SAFE FOR KIDS
• Team-wide chat for coaches, parents, and players
• Parents-only and staff-only threads for logistics
• Players can't receive private messages from adults — every conversation with a player is visible to the team
• Mute any conversation
• Report or block anyone, and coaches can remove messages

TEAM DUES WITHOUT THE CHASING
• Coaches request season dues, tournament fees, or uniform costs
• Families pay you in one tap with Venmo or Cash App
• Track who's paid, record cash payments, and waive fees

PRIVACY FIRST
• No ads and no third-party trackers
• Children under 13 don't have accounts — parents manage their profiles
• Delete your account any time from the app

Everything is free for coaches, parents, and players.

Terms of Use: https://teamclubhq.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://teamclubhq.com/privacy
Questions? info@teamclubhq.com

version_1_0.coach_pro_description_section:
COACH PRO (OPTIONAL)
Everything parents and players use is free, forever. Head coaches who run more than one team can upgrade to Coach Pro: up to 3 teams, season attendance reports, roster export, one-tap payment reminders, and custom team colors.
• Coach Pro Monthly: $9.99/month
• Coach Pro Yearly: $69.99/year
• Eligible new subscribers get a 2-week free trial
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

app_review_information.notes:
ClubHQ Team is a youth sports team app for coaches, parents, and players.

DEMO ACCOUNT: sign in with the credentials above (head coach of 'ClubHQ Test Team', which has upcoming practices and games, a 10-player roster, team and parents-only chat, announcements, and a dues request). Additional test logins on the same team: parent pat.parent.e2e@teamclubhq.com / ParentTest-2026! and player (age 14) riley.player.e2e@teamclubhq.com / PlayerTest-2026!.

NEW ACCOUNTS verify email with a 6-digit code sent from info@teamclubhq.com. Sign-up includes a neutral birth-year age screen; people under 13 cannot create accounts (parents manage children's profiles, per COPPA).

CHILD SAFETY & MODERATION: players (13+) can only post in team-wide chat visible to coaches and parents; adults cannot message players privately. Teams are invite-only. In any chat, tap ••• → Report a Concern, or long-press a message to Report it (emails info@teamclubhq.com with the message details; we respond within 24 hours) or Block its author (hides their messages). Coaches can delete any message. Announcements can be reported with a long-press.

PAYMENTS: this version has no in-app payments and no In-App Purchases. Dues are tracking only: coaches create payment requests and mark cash, Venmo, or Cash App payments as paid. A head coach can add the team's Venmo username / $Cashtag (Team → Team Settings → Payments); parents then see 'Pay with Venmo' / 'Pay with Cash App' buttons that open those apps with the amount filled in. These pay the coach directly for real-world team costs (guideline 3.1.3(e)); ClubHQ takes no fee.

ACCOUNT DELETION: More tab → Delete Account.

There is also a demo mode on the sign-in screen ("Just looking?" → Coach, Parent, or Player) that requires no account.
app_review_information.coach_pro_review_notes: COACH PRO (auto-renewable subscription, group 'Coach Pro'): sign in as coach@teamclubhq.com → More → Upgrade to Coach Pro (also offered when creating a second team, and in Team Settings → Team color). The paywall is StoreKit's SubscriptionStoreView with Restore Purchases, Terms of Use (https://teamclubhq.com/terms) and Privacy Policy links. Purchases are verified server-side from Apple's signed transactions; Pro unlocks up to 3 teams, Season Report with export, dues reminders, and team colors.

testflight.beta_app_description: ClubHQ Team is an ad-free team app for youth sports. Coaches create a team and share a team code; parents join with the code and add their kids; players 13+ get their own login from a parent or coach. Please try: create an account (you'll get a 6-digit email code), then create a team or join one with a code from your coach, RSVP to an event, and send a team chat message. Tell us anything confusing or broken!
testflight.what_to_test: First beta! Please test: (1) creating an account and entering the emailed code, (2) coaches: create a team, add a practice, share the team code, (3) parents: join with a team code and add your child, (4) RSVP and team chat. Payments and Coach Pro purchases are not enabled yet.

in_app_purchases.review_note: Unlocks coach features only (multiple teams, reports, export, reminders, team colors). Everything parents and players use is free. Sign in as coach@teamclubhq.com, More → Upgrade to Coach Pro.
